definitions.explanation: A soft-bodied mollusk that carries a spiral shell on its back. Snails move slowly and are associated with rainy weather in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨上|あめあ}がり→雨上がり：14586_ameagari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A snail came out after the rain stopped.

examples.japanese: {蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: A snail is slowly crawling on a leaf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}って→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing by touching the snail's shell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: When the rainy season comes, I spot snails here and there in the garden.

examples.japanese: {蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{少|すこ}しずつ→少しずつ：20047_sukoshizutsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいく→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧。
examples.english: Snails move slowly, but their appearance as they gradually inch forward over time is cute.

notes:
{蝸牛|かたつむり} refers to land snails (not sea snails).

Alternative forms:
- カタツムリ (katakana, common in scientific contexts)
- でんでん⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (colloquial/children's term)
- {蝸牛|まいまい} (alternative reading, dialectal)

Common expressions:
- {蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}み→歩み：13195_ayumi⟧ (snail's pace)
- {蝸牛|かたつむり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧ (snail's shell)

Counter: ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧

Cultural note:
The children's song 「でんでん⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧むし{蝸牛|かたつむり}」is famous in Japan. Snails are associated with the rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧) and are a symbol of early summer.
